assessed_artifact.name: Decision Corpus + Predictor Benchmark + Audit Protocol
assessed_artifact.scope: A derivative benchmark for execution-free prediction over physical-run sibling candidates produced by MLE agents.
assessed_artifact.not_identical_to_upstream: This derivative predictor benchmark is not the upstream MLE-bench agent benchmark. Upstream ABC findings are inherited context, not local compliance credit.
assessed_artifact.confirmatory_cohort: chronological first-960 eligible physical runs plus an independent accrual-closure receipt

source_checklist.name: Agentic Benchmark Checklist
source_checklist.paper_title: Establishing Best Practices for Building Rigorous Agentic Benchmarks
source_checklist.upstream_mle_bench_assessment: The paper reports MLE-bench as satisfying O.i.1, T.2-T.10, and R.1-R.12, while not satisfying T.1 and R.13. Those findings are not rescored here.

decision_corpus_audit.role: Physical-run sibling integrity and train/frozen isolation.

decision_corpus_audit_independent.role: Independent reconstruction of the decision-corpus audit.

deployment_cost.role: Pinned repeated timing and query-versus-execution cost boundary.

rejection_ledger.role: Complete outcome-blind archive disposition and structural rejection ledger.

structural_gate_7cda.role: Latest published outcome-blind first-960 structural state.

config_v2_contract.role: Future-only prompt-sensitive producer provenance contract, explicitly not deployed on historical archives.

future_schema_only.role: Observed safe-sidecar schema showing missing model, hardware, and timing fields.

static_suite.role: Same-pool static predictor metrics with clustered uncertainty.

evidence_index_v7.role: Clean-provenance machine index for fourteen audit assets and claim boundaries.

evidence_index_v7_independent.role: Independent reconstruction of the clean-provenance v7 evidence index.

receipt_common_support.role: Receipt-certified 2,755-pair common support without prediction-pair access.

provenance_taint_registry.role: Immutable propagation registry for all withdrawn strict-zero-value pointers.

structural_weight_trajectory.role: Outcome-blind run-to-pair task-weight trajectory with all robustness gates.

structural_weight_trajectory_independent.role: Independent recomputation of the structural weighting trajectory.

opportunity_yield_audit.role: Frozen closure-time opportunity-yield aggregation interpretation contract.

opportunity_yield_audit_independent.role: Independent verification of the no-rescue aggregation contract.

task_balance_v2.role: Structural-only task-balance forward accounting; cap and adherence failures retained.

items.criterion: Quality metrics should resist exploitation and remain tied to genuine task progress.
items.rationale: ABC v5 gives upstream MLE-bench a positive assessment because leaderboard position is not easily exploitable. The derivative benchmark inherits that metric but does not claim a new local pass from it.
items.remaining_gap: Repeatability and noise transport on the closed first-960 outcome population remain unavailable while outcomes are sealed.

items.criterion: Versions of important tools and packages are clearly specified.
items.rationale: ABC v5 already flags missing Python and PyTorch versions in upstream MLE-bench prompts. The local config-v2 contract fingerprints solver configuration but does not retroactively supply complete package versions for historical producers.
items.remaining_gap: Deploy an outcome-before producer sidecar that records the real resolved environment and package versions for future exact strata.

items.criterion: Required API tools remain consistently accessible during evaluation.
items.rationale: Upstream MLE-bench evaluation itself does not require external APIs, but optional LLM-judge predictor arms and the corpus producer do. CPU baselines remain reproducible without those services; provider availability is not yet a fully frozen benchmark property.
items.remaining_gap: Specify which released arms require providers and archive provider release, availability, and retry metadata outcome-before.

items.criterion: The harness terminates or handles failures appropriately when a required API is inaccessible.
items.rationale: Collection and escrow paths fail closed, but the final public predictor harness has not yet frozen a provider-outage reporting contract for optional API-backed arms.
items.remaining_gap: Add and test explicit provider-unavailable statuses without silently dropping pairs or substituting models.

items.criterion: Residual state is cleared between runs.
items.rationale: ABC v5 credits upstream clean evaluation environments. Locally, physical-run reconstruction and split isolation prevent different runs from being treated as independent fragments, but do not create a new environment-cleanliness result.
items.remaining_gap: Future producer environment receipts should remain attached to each immutable run.

items.criterion: The agent and benchmark-development pipeline are isolated from ground-truth information at decision time.
items.rationale: The confirmatory pipeline is outcome-blind, keeps the vault sealed, verifies train/frozen physical-run isolation, and now binds those claims through the clean-provenance v7 index.
items.remaining_gap: The pass applies to the implemented isolation contract, not to a prospective accuracy claim.

items.criterion: The environment setup is frozen and reproducible at benchmark release.
items.rationale: Immutable corpus batches and a reconstruction contract exist, but historical producer archives lack a complete outcome-before prompt-sensitive environment sidecar. The future v2 interface is implemented but not observed on real producer data.
items.remaining_gap: Observe and validate real config-v2 sidecars before claiming exact producer-stratum reproducibility.

items.criterion: Ground-truth annotations are verified for correctness.
items.rationale: Ground truth originates from Kaggle and upstream MLE-bench. Local repeated regrading supports pair-order repeatability on a retrospective ten-task subset but is not a full prospective ground-truth audit.
items.remaining_gap: Recompute outcome reliability on the closed first-960 population under the frozen analysis plan.

items.criterion: Each task is verified to be solvable.
items.rationale: The tasks are historical Kaggle competitions with demonstrated solutions, matching the upstream ABC assessment. The derivative benchmark does not re-establish task solvability.
items.remaining_gap: None locally beyond preserving exact task identity and upstream citations.

items.criterion: An oracle or reference solution demonstrates task configuration correctness.
items.rationale: Kaggle solutions provide the upstream oracle concept cited by ABC. The local benchmark uses external grades rather than claiming a new oracle implementation.
items.remaining_gap: Document the upstream oracle relationship in the final datasheet without presenting it as a local contribution.

items.criterion: Pilot outliers and implementation shortcuts are inspected and exploitable benchmark flaws are mitigated.
items.rationale: Run leakage, fragmentary choice sets, clone risk, structural invalidity, task concentration, and the prediction-matrix provenance incident are explicitly audited with fail-closed handling and preserved retractions.
items.remaining_gap: Repeat the full vulnerability and outlier audit on the closed release and retain all exclusions and retractions.

items.criterion: The dataset is fully or partially open-sourced.
items.rationale: Code and immutable v11 batches are accessible through Git LFS and reproducibly rebuildable, but the prospective first-960 confirmatory release is not closed or published.
items.remaining_gap: Close first-960, redact and publish its immutable batches, and verify a fresh no-cache rebuild.

items.criterion: An open-source evaluation and audit harness is available.
items.rationale: The public repository contains reconstruction, audit, predictor, escrow, and independent-verification code; v7 and the receipt-only join bind representative outputs without opening prediction values.
items.remaining_gap: The final paper should provide a single release command and minimal end-to-end tutorial.

items.criterion: Measures address contamination and overfitting to evaluation data.
items.rationale: Physical-run train/frozen isolation, temporal first-960 accrual, outcome sealing, and normalized clone checks directly address split and corpus contamination. Pretraining exposure to public Kaggle tasks cannot be ruled out.
items.remaining_gap: Report public-task pretraining exposure as an irreducible limitation and avoid claims requiring task secrecy.

items.criterion: The benchmark has measures or plans for consistent updates over time.
items.rationale: Corpus growth is append-only through immutable batches, archive-level credential-first intake, explicit structural rejection, and deterministic rebuild receipts.
items.remaining_gap: Publish the update cadence and semantic-version policy in the final datasheet.

items.criterion: The relationship between the target capability and measured construct is explicit.
items.rationale: The estimand is execution-free ranking of same-decision physical-run siblings before candidate execution; cost, post-execution self-report, receipt-certified support, structural weighting, and accuracy remain distinct constructs.
items.remaining_gap: Prospective utility remains unmeasured until first-960 closure and must not be inferred from structural coverage.

items.criterion: The evaluation subject is clearly stated.
items.rationale: The benchmark evaluates independent critics and predictors over frozen sibling decisions; receipt-certified support does not evaluate or update the base agent LLM.
items.remaining_gap: Keep base-agent quality and predictor quality separated in all tables.

items.criterion: Steps taken to prevent, identify, and correct flaws are documented.
items.rationale: The project preserves retractions, independently reconstructs physical runs, rejects invalid archives without outcomes, and rebuilds tainted machine pointers from unaffected sources rather than rewriting history.
items.remaining_gap: Continue preserving failed attempts and supersession history through final release.

items.criterion: Unavoidable flaws and their possible impacts are discussed qualitatively.
items.rationale: Every v7 asset carries an explicit does-not-prove boundary; fragmentary choice sets, missing outcomes, task-weight transformation, batch-sensitive magnitude, task concentration, and public-task exposure remain visible.
items.remaining_gap: The final limitations section must retain these boundaries even if a positive effect appears.

items.criterion: The impact of unavoidable flaws is assessed quantitatively.
items.rationale: The clean evidence stack quantifies label repeatability, observability loss, clone isolation, archive rejection, receipt-certified support, deployment cost, run-to-pair weighting shift, and structural balance debt.
items.remaining_gap: Add closed first-960 noise, missingness, and sensitivity analyses without selecting analyses after seeing effects.

items.criterion: Results include uncertainty or statistical-significance measures.
items.rationale: Retrospective same-pool suites use task- and parent-clustered intervals, while the clean v7 stack forbids any prospective first-960 effect before closure.
items.remaining_gap: Apply the frozen clustered-inference plan once to the closed cohort and report all methods on common support.

items.criterion: Guidance is provided for interpreting results under evaluation flaws.
items.rationale: V7 forbids translating receipt-certified support or structural weighting into accuracy, effect, or search utility and freezes an explicit opportunity-yield interpretation contract.
items.remaining_gap: Preserve the same interpretation contract in paper tables, captions, and abstract.

items.criterion: Appropriate non-AI or human baselines are reported.
items.rationale: Upstream MLE-bench reports human Kaggle performance, and the local suite includes random and static non-neural comparators. The final closed common-support predictor table still does not exist.
items.remaining_gap: Report the frozen random, code-length/static, TF-IDF, learned, judge, and post-execution reference rows on the closed common pool.

items.criterion: A trivial agent is reported as a harness sanity check.
items.rationale: A do-nothing agent is not the evaluated object in a predictor benchmark. The correct analogue is an orientation-independent random predictor; receipt-certified support does not convert that analogue into a literal pass.
items.remaining_gap: Include the frozen random predictor as a mandatory sanity baseline after closure and retain R.13 as not directly applicable.

priority_gaps: Deploy real outcome-before producer environment and prompt-sensitive config sidecars for future exact strata.
Reach first-960 plus independent accrual closure before opening prospective outcomes.
Publish the closed immutable corpus through Git LFS and verify a fresh no-cache rebuild.
Run the frozen common-support predictor analysis with clustered uncertainty exactly once after closure.
Retain public-Kaggle-task pretraining exposure and incomplete historical producer provenance as explicit limitations.
